name: Campillo de Deleitosa (Spain)
description: White field with a blue saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Campillo de Deleitosa (a chequy field and a star on red).
history: The arms and the flag of Campillo de Deleitosa were approved by the Order of 16 December 2004 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 8 January 2005, after the municipal council's approval on 1 September 2004.

features.role: Campillo de Deleitosa arms — chequy and star
